claims.claim: testOneRegi is one of three 80_optimization realizations (nash, negishi, testOneRegi), selected via %optimization%
Reduces REMIND to a single region; equivalent to Nash with one region
Prices of resources/goods are exogenously fixed from the gdx rather than solved via market clearing
Runtime is a few minutes, since one region is optimized instead of ~12
claims.note: The '~12 regions' figure is the answer's own addition (it matches the default H12 setup). It isn't in the doc comment, but it's harmless.

claims.claim: The debugging tutorial documents `start.R --debug --interactive --testOneRegi`, which restarts from the last good fulldata.gdx
@limitations: only useful for testing or for regions with no influence on global prices of traded goods; not a substitute for nash/negishi in production
